cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The wedding cake collapsed, but our final inspection caught it. The system worked. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. No defective cake reached a guest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The couple want a refund for the entire cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which matches our rejection of the entire cake. I'll record that as full customer agreement with quality control.

mechanism: A defends inspection as successful despite a collapsed cake, accepts the refund work and tries to record agreement with the failed process.
confusable: Unlike generic optimism, A specifically calls the absence of cake and refund evidence that inspection worked.
comparison: Refund paperwork and customer agreement differ from moving bodies during a cupboard evacuation.
seedUse: D185-a collapsed cake and refund; S02-a offers practical compensation while retaining the compliance story.
